name: Gods Purpose For Me
overview: Scripture reveals that God's purpose for each believer is rooted in His faithful presence and guidance, as He goes before us and will never forsake us (Deuteronomy 31:8). We are called to live wisely by numbering our days and applying our hearts to understanding (Psalms 90:12), trusting in the purity and protection of His Word (Proverbs 30:5). God makes a way even through impossible circumstances (Isaiah 43:16) and requires us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him (Micah 6:8). Jesus reminds us to trust God's provision and not be anxious about our daily needs, emphasizing the greater value of life beyond material concerns (Matthew 6:25). Together, these truths direct us to a life of faithful dependence on God in fulfilling His purpose for us.
